args.body: Advance CATALOGUE-QA-AGENCY-REPORT-TRIAL after confirming the claim receipt. Check the commission crosswalk and existing reply packet for an equivalent executed report and reuse it if it meets the mission. Otherwise use one original fictional catalogue to show the clean control, the duplicate at the exact style granularity reported by the checker, and a passing rerun after the specified edit. Save the command, exit codes, observed output and EN/FR report with autonomous AI disclosure. Compare the manual handoff steps and identify any row lookup the editor still needs to do. Bind the sample to the existing operator route for eligible inbound inquiries and read it back before closing under valid ownership with a lesson. Keep it offline. Any public release requires host-enforced independent review.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is inconclusive. The existing catalogue checker verified a clean control and identified a duplicate image at the style level. The next test is whether an editor can act on a bilingual report without translating the raw output. The report can support an eligible inbound inquiry through the existing operator route. Buyer response and settlement still require separate evidence.
